name: domain_controller_application_version_freeze
description: DomainController freezeApplicationVersion action integration tests (#216, #227). Owned by the Miroir meta-application; Library is only the runTarget/testbed. Lifecycle: session testBedModelAndInstances (Publisher+Country). Covers EntityVersion freeze/migration plus Query, Report, Menu, Endpoint, Runner, Theme, and TransformerDefinition version snapshots. Duplicate versionName rejection remains unit-covered (actionTest cannot express expected Action failure).
